apps.localizedDescription:
We do not support piracy, It is forbidden to request copyrighted content.

Do I need a Switch to use this emulator?:

MeloNX emulator is capable of running many homebrew applications, and can be a crucial tool in the development and debugging of homebrew applications and games. To play commercial games, you will need access to a Switch compatible with custom firmware (CFW), which will enable you to dump your system firmware, keys and legally purchased games.

How can I dump my firmware/games/keys?:

First, you need to hack your Nintendo Switch, which you can learn how to do here: https://nh-server.github.io/switch-guide/.

Info:

• A Paid Developer account or TrollStore may be needed for specific devices (Read about Entitlements below).
• MeloNX REQUIRES JIT and CANNOT run without it.

versions.localizedDescription:
Highlights:

• Ram Limit Workaround using NSExtensions and xpc_shmem.

• This does NOT contribute to the in-app "Memory limit tester ".

• In-App Controller Remapping.
• Controller Navigation.
• (experimental) Steam Controller Support via CoreBluetooth.
• iOS 27 AirPlay Support.
• Add MetalFX Upscaling.

Core & Graphics:

• Improved Async Shader Compilation.
• NSExtensions and xpc_shmem for offloading Guest RAM to NSExtensions, shared mem does not contribute to the main app's phys_footprint.
• Fix fragment ClipDistance SPIR-V lookup.
• Add BCn > ETC2 Texture Recompression for GPUs that do not support BCn.
• Memory Pressure GPU Buffer Eviction.
• Add MetalFX Spatial Upscaling.

UI & Controllers:

• Game List Controller Navigation.
• Full Controller Remapping.
• Fix Opacity with Virtual Controls.
• Move Firmware Importing off the Main Thread and Improve Error Reporting.
• (experimental) Steam Controller Support via CoreBluetooth.
• Anti-Aliasing option added to Settings.
• Fix Virtual Controller not disabling when option is enabled.
• Improve Per-Game Settings.
• Open Save Folder option.
